name: tool-bash
description: The `bash` tool: one host_process.run of `bash -c`, exit status and output returned as data. Reaches nothing else — and the operator sees the command as argv, not as a shell string buried in a payload.

tool.name: bash
tool.description: Run a command with bash -c in the workspace and return its exit status, stdout and stderr. Not interactive: nothing is fed to stdin. Each of stdout and stderr is cut at 262144 bytes and the result marked as truncated when either was. A nonzero exit status marks the result as an error.

command.description: The command line, as bash would read it.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock limit (default 120000). On expiry the process group is killed and the call fails.
